attack_patterns: presence of hidden or obfuscated JavaScript for browser manipulation
login forms with suspicious or non-standard action URLs
URLs with unrelated or suspicious domain names and excessive subdomains
embedding hidden 1x1 pixel images for tracking
mismatch between page content branding and URL domain
attack_sophistication_levels: basic phishing with static fake login forms
intermediate obfuscation using hidden inputs and tracking pixels
advanced API hooking and dynamic JavaScript manipulation
complex domain impersonation with multi-level subdomains and brand name obfuscation
mitigation_strategies: URL validation and domain consistency enforcement
JavaScript behavior monitoring and API hooking detection
user awareness and social engineering training
detection_approaches: multi-modal feature extraction combining HTML content and URL analysis
pattern matching for suspicious form action URLs and JavaScript signatures
DOM analysis to detect hidden elements and API overrides
threshold-based alerting on pixel counts and URL complexity
continuous monitoring of external resource domains
